notes.title: ERR - 001 will be gone from Steam!
notes.content:
Oh my, where do I start? Ok so obviously this game has a mixed rating but before anyone says anything; that does not impact this decision at all.

It's often said that creators won't always like the stuff they make a while after making it but wow do I hate this game now! I mean, my intention of using RPG Maker to make games is to NOT make typical RPG Maker games and this game is like a text book example of typical. XD

Despite this being a free game I just don't wanna see it anymore on Steam. We've got enough shovelware around that we really don't need this one! :P

Anyway, for those who have played it an enjoyed it; congrats on doing something I couldn't. And for those who think it's bad; I agree with you all too well. XD
